parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, which sits under the `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/` directory tree — the canonical sample-app-mirror location. The decision rules treat any record under `Examples/` or `SampleApp/` as a restraint marker regardless of the `is_sample_app` flag value. Extracting the shared `DebugMetricsProvider.updateMetrics` implementation into a common location would couple the production `DebugPanel` package to demonstration-context semantics. The duplication here is intentional: the sample app carries its own local copy of the debug HUD logic so it can remain self-contained.
